definitions.gloss: intermission between acts of a play
definitions.explanation: The break between acts or scenes of a play, opera, or other stage performance, when the curtain is down and the audience can rest.

examples.japanese: {幕間|まくあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a drink during the intermission.

examples.japanese: {幕間|まくあい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十分|にじゅっぷん}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The intermission is twenty minutes long.

examples.japanese: {幕間|まくあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: During the intermission, I happened to run into an acquaintance in the lobby.

notes:
Refers specifically to the pause between acts of a stage performance. The reading まくあい is standard; まくま is also heard. Originally a theater term from kabuki.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幕間|まくあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to rest during the intermission
- {幕間|まくあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: the length of the intermission
- {幕間|まくあい}⟦{狂言|きょうげん}→狂言：04456_kyougen⟧: a short interlude piece performed between acts

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧: break; rest — a general break, not tied to a performance
- インターミッション: intermission — the loanword, used for films and concerts
